name: Rex Wilde
occupation: Cabinet maker (34 years, per his 2022 statement)
military: U.S. Army, including the 259th BCT, the 82nd Airborne, and the 1022 medical detachment of the National Guard in Cheyenne
background: Rex Wilde of Cheyenne ran as a Democrat for governor in 2022. In a 2022 statement dictated by telephone, he said he had served in the 259th BCT, the 82nd Airborne, and the 1022 medical detachment of the National Guard in Cheyenne, that he is bilingual in Italian and English, and that he had been a cabinet maker for 34 years.
